body:
### Fixed
- Fixed the invalid card session signature (`InvalidCardSignatureException`) in PKI mode when the CA certificate is not registered and the secure session is opened in a `processCommands` call that does not close it: the CA certificate is now read from the card before the opening of the secure session instead of inside it (issue [#133]).
- The CA certificate is no longer read twice when its Get Data command is prepared by the application in the same `processCommands` call as the opening of the secure session.
### Added
- Support of the "Put Data" command with the AID tag (4Fh) and the Stored Value link tag (D0h) through `preparePutData(PutDataTag.APPLICATION_AID, ...)` and `preparePutData(PutDataTag.STORED_VALUE_LINK, ...)`. These commands are allowed only within a secure session opened in symmetric crypto mode; the card rejects them if the session is not opened with the `PERSONALIZATION` level (issue [#131]).
### Upgraded
- Keypop Calypso Card API `2.2.0` -> `2.3.0`
